text:
dave-fin: Heads up — international billing run for Virox Labs failed for 2 of 3 cards. Processor returned `AUTH_REJECT_3DS` and one `DO_NOT_HONOR`. Need immediate plan: retries, wire fallback, and comms.

mina-payments: Can you paste last4 + payment ids? Also whether tokens are on different acquirers.

dave-fin: last4: 3344, 7770. payment ids pay_vxA1..., pay_vxA2... (DMing full ids). Looks like both routed to our primary acquirer.

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed count=2 codes=[AUTH_REJECT_3DS, DO_NOT_HONOR] event=payment.failed.

jules-support: Customer ticket #7010: "Why did our cards fail?" They specifically asked if we can accept a bank wire — they prefer that for cross-border.

mina-payments: Plan: 1) Pause automated retries for those tokens. 2) Offer secure wire instructions + invoice link. 3) If they request, accept one-time manual wire and mark invoice paid on receipt; do not attempt further card retries. 4) Approve a small temporary credit hold (up to $15k) to prevent service disruption while wire clears.

ana-ops: typo — I'm Ana-ops. Approve temporary credit hold up to $15k for Virox while wire clears. Add metadata temp_hold=15k_approved and notify collections if not resolved in 10 business days.

leo-legal: Quick notes: use language "issuing bank declined" not "fraud" or "card failed due to 3DS" in customer-facing comms. For wire instructions, use the standard finance wire template link and send via secure email or the customer portal — do not paste full account/routing numbers in Slack. Record any credit holds in Zendesk.

jules-support: Draft customer response:

Hi Virox Labs — we attempted your scheduled invoices but a subset of cards was declined by the issuing bank; no funds were captured. We can pause retries and provide secure bank wire instructions and an invoice link if you prefer. Once the wire is received we will mark the invoice paid immediately. Alternatively, if you want us to retry with an alternate routing, let us know. Please reply with your preference.

— Redwood Billing

mina-payments: I'll pause retries and create the secure invoice link. If they pick wire, I'll mark the payments as awaiting_wire and set the temp_hold flag. Command (internal): /payments set-meta acct_virox temp_hold=15k_approved await_payment=wire; /invoice link create --acct acct_virox --expires 7d

billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_virox-7010 (expires in 7 days).

jules-support: Sent the message in ticket #7010 via secure channel. Customer replied: "Please send wire instructions and we'll initiate today." :white_check_mark:

mina-payments: Cancelled retries and marked payments `awaiting_wire`. Billing note added: "temp_hold=15k approved by ana-ops; awaiting wire — invoice link sent."

leo-legal: Thanks. When wire confirmation arrives, finance should attach the bank confirmation to Zendesk but not the raw bank details in Slack.

dave-fin: Closing thread — status: retries paused, invoice link sent, awaiting wire, temp hold approved. Will update when wire clears. :thumbsup:
